sophie (Comms): Quick follow-up from today's postmortem. Need to lock the customer-facing cadence: statuspage blurb, 72h summary, and public RCA release flow. Who picks up the redaction checklist?

raj (SRE): I'll own the checklist and the initial PR. Will include examples of sensitive fields to remove. Need legal to confirm the rules for quoting logs.

maria (Customer Success): For timelines: we should promise a concise customer summary within 72h and an RCA within 14 days unless redaction/legal hold requires more time. CS needs a reuseable snippet for outreach.

oliver (Legal): 72h summary okay. For RCAs, if customer data or contractual items are referenced, legal must review before distribution. I'll provide a short sign-off flow.

anya (Ops): Also want a lightweight statuspage template we can copy into outage posts. Keep it neutral and actionable.

sophie (Comms): Proposed templates below, please thumbs-up or suggest edits.

```
Statuspage short: "We experienced elevated errors affecting <service>. We deployed a mitigation and service returned to normal at <end>. We will publish a follow-up summary within 72 hours."

72h customer summary: - Impact snapshot - Mitigation performed - Immediate user guidance (if any) - What we're doing next (owners + ETA) - Contact for support

RCA public: Detailed timeline, root cause, permanent fixes, verification steps, owner and ETA. Redaction applied per checklist.
```

raj (SRE): Checklist items I plan to include: remove PII & secrets, replace customer hostnames with generic tokens, redact stack traces that contain identifying paths, avoid verbatim log lines that include customer identifiers. Also add a flag for "requires-customer-consent".

maria (Customer Success): Consent flag is critical. If we want to include a customer quote or example, we need explicit opt-in from the customer and a copy-approved message they sign off on.

oliver (Legal): I'll create a two-step sign-off: legal quick review -> written consent from customer (if needed) -> comms final sign-off. I'll add specific examples of unacceptable content.

incident-bot: Reminder: create INCIDENT-4720 in incidents tracker with 72h due for 72h summary.

sophie (Comms): Action items assigned:
- Redaction checklist (owner: raj) 148h
- Statuspage short templates (owner: sophie) 12h
- Consent & sign-off flow doc (owner: oliver) 144h
- CS reuse snippets for 72h (owner: maria) 5 business days

raj (SRE): I'll also add a small automated query snippet to the postmortem template to surface previous incidents with similar error signatures over the past 180 days. Call it `recurring-pattern-check`.

anya (Ops): Good. Ops will ensure the runbook has a pointer to the template so on-call can copy/paste the short copy immediately.

maria (Customer Success): Please include a short "what we're doing for you" blurb in the 72h summary (3 lines) so CS can forward to customers without edits.

sophie (Comms): Noted. I'll add that snippet. Also adding a short FAQ section to the 72h so common customer questions are pre-answered.

oliver (Legal): I'll post the consent examples and the sign-off checklist in the doc and add a one-click acceptance phrase for customers to sign if they agree to be quoted.

raj (SRE): Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/incidents/pull/189 - includes checklist + sample redaction examples + `recurring-pattern-check` query.

sophie (Comms): Thanks. Once PR is merged, I'll publish the templates to the internal comms playbook and create the incident-task items. Please react with :+1: to accept ownership.

raj (SRE): :+1:

maria (Customer Success): :+1:

oliver (Legal): :+1:

incident-bot: Task created: INCIDENT-4720 (customer-comms-playbook) 172h due for 72h summary, 14d for public RCA.

sophie (Comms): Leaving this thread open for any edge cases (regulated customers, on-prem customers). If you see a special-case incident, tag me and legal immediately.
